title: Clair Obscur - Location, Weakness & Rewards
description: Clair Obscur in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - where to find it, its elemental weakness and resistances, and how to beat it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: The Clair Obscur is a boss form of the paired Clair and Obscur enemies, found in the Tainted Lumiere area of The Monolith. It shares their silhouette but carries far more health and a heavier attack set, and it drops Dreameso.

sections.title: How to Beat the Clair Obscur
sections.content:
What actually kills you

Chromatic variants hit harder and hold more health than the enemy they are based on. The failure mode is almost always running out of resources mid-fight rather than a mechanic you did not understand, so bring healing headroom rather than a greedier damage build.

No elemental shortcut

With no weakness to exploit, the fight is decided by your upgrade levels and your parry timing. Check that your weapons are current before attempting it.
